hook.text: When Tesla revealed the Cybertruck in 2019, half the audience gasped and the other half laughed.

buildup.text: Its angular stainless steel body looked like nothing on the road—sharp edges, no curves, no paint.

discovery.text: The exoskeleton design eliminated the traditional body-on-frame, using the skin as the structure.

twist.text: The 'unbreakable' window famously shattered on stage during the reveal. Musk just said 'oh my god.'

climax.text: Love it or hate it, the Cybertruck proved that car design rules can still be broken in 2024.

punchline.text: The most polarizing car ever built sells out anyway.
